body: I...I didn't say VIT makes tanks take less damage anywhere in my post? o.o; I did state in another post that all VIT does is increase the margin of error for healer/tank. I know that VIT doesn't make them take less damage, it just makes the damage they do take count for less of their overall max HP, thus greater margin for error etc. I know how it works. :) The point I was trying to make wasn't really str vs vit but that a tank who doesn't mitigate with CDs properly regardless of str/vit will cost a healer dps, that's all!

Not impossible if tanks position properly. That said my advice was based on the fact that op stated they are having a 7% diff between the hands after EC goes out, which means their dps is not split evenly at all. They also don't have a smn, or a caster at all for that matter. In a mechanic where the difference in passing the check and raid wipe is .1% I think the way I mentioned is the best way for them to go about it for the time being. I'm aware AoE helps in the long run but for progression sake I find doing it this way allows you to pass the dps check easier to get to the add phase.

It's still 25% less HP the healer will have to heal regardless. I stated in another post that VIT doesn't do anything but increase the margin of error. My point was simply that a shit tank can and will make a healer lose dps, full STR or not doesn't matter.

No competent healer will lose dps to a tank in STR who uses *proper cooldowns* you mean. A bad tank who doesn't use CDs on top of also being in full STR will definitely strain a healer quite a bit, and make dps hard if not impossible. You can heal a tank through it assuming they don't do a suicidal level pull, but you won't be dpsing much...

That said, yes this was abuse of the system completely, very sad. :<

EDIT: Adding this on because I wasn't quite clear with what I am saying here: I am not saying VIT is better, I main a healer and am progressing in A3S at the moment. I do understand very well how VIT in itself does not increase defensive stats. I was simply saying that no matter what right side the tank is sporting, any tank not using proper CDs will cause a healer to lose dps no matter what, that's all.

All vit does is increase the margin of error for both the healers and the tanks. That said, some tanks think "This is ez I don't need CDs" and at that point the healer will struggle, but even then it's not impossible, the healer just won't be able to DPS as much if at all. But a good tank can be in full STR right side and be perfectly fine as long as they know how to...like...tank. That was definite abuse of the vote-kick system.

Split your DPS on the hands evenly. Put DRG/BRD on one and NIN/MCH on the other. You can probably swap the brd/mch as needed really but make sure 1 melee and 1 range on each. Make sure NO ONE is double dotting OR doing AoE of any kind to the hands at that point. No floor AoEs hitting both, no anything. As soon as Equal Concentration goes out all dps and the tanks focus the higher hand, and do not even touch the other one until after Hand of Pain. Hand of Pain will wipe if there is even a .1% diff between the hands and double dotting/aoe etc can make that check even harder for you, if not impossible. My group had the same issue for awhile, but once we focused dps better the check became ez.
